testimonials.text: I came in for chronic shoulder and neck tension, and Dr. Park took the time to understand my stress, sleep, and daily habits before starting treatment. After several acupuncture sessions, I felt looser, calmer, and much more like myself again.

The herbal medicine recommendations were thoughtful and easy to follow, and I appreciated how clearly everything was explained. I felt supported the whole time, and my energy and digestion gradually became much more balanced.

As a Mandarin-speaking patient, I felt immediately comfortable here. Dr. Park’s acupuncture treatments helped with my menstrual discomfort, and the care always felt gentle, respectful, and deeply attentive.

I tried cupping therapy for persistent upper back tightness and was surprised by how much relief I felt afterward. The clinic is spotless, calming, and very professional, which made the whole experience even better.

The tuina massage sessions were incredibly helpful for stiffness and overall tension from long workdays. I left each visit feeling more open, grounded, and relaxed, and the results built steadily over time.
